nodes.name: Dynamic H2 bubble template deposition of NiW
nodes.procedure: Using a dynamic H2 bubble template (DHBT) method, NiW bimetallic alloys were uniformly deposited on a NM substrate. DHBT utilizes a high cathodic current density that simultaneously accelerates metal ion reduction and induces vigorous H2 evolution on the conductive NM substrate. During this process, Ni2+ and WO4 2− ions are co-reduced onto the NM substrate, resulting in a porous NiW bimetallic alloy architecture.
